This unit is one file, src/orders/presentation/orders.controller.ts, and it has one concern: exposing the order lifecycle over HTTP under the 'orders' route. Each handler only maps request parameters and bodies onto an application use-case input and hands it off. It holds no business rules or invariants, so none can be duplicated.

Reads and writes take different paths:
- Reads: getOrders and getOrder go through the QueryBus, using GetOrdersQuery and GetOrderQuery.
- Writes: commands go through use-case services injected directly into the controller.

This is a deliberate CQRS split that the controller applies the same way every time. It does not bypass the module's abstractions: no handler skips the application layer, and no handler talks to repositories or domain entities directly.
